title: b11529
summary: ggml: fix OOB write in ggml_acc with negative offset ( #30135 ) ggml_acc_impl narrowed a size_t offset to int32_t without checking that it fits, so a large offset could truncate to a negative int32_t. The forward then sign-extended it to a huge size_t and the bounds assertion wrapped, allowing an OOB write below the dst buffer. Check the offset before the narrowing, matching the existing check in ggml_set_impl. Websi
body:
ggml: fix OOB write in ggml_acc with negative offset ( #30135 )

ggml_acc_impl narrowed a size_t offset to int32_t without checking that it

fits, so a large offset could truncate to a negative int32_t. The forward

then sign-extended it to a huge size_t and the bounds assertion wrapped,

allowing an OOB write below the dst buffer. Check the offset before the

narrowing, matching the existing check in ggml_set_impl.
